title: Objection handling scenarios
description: Scenario-based practice for handling the objections that come up most often on partner and customer calls.

questions.context: A prospect says: "We already have a manual KYC process and it works fine — why would we change it?"

options.label: Ask what "works fine" is costing them in time and drop-off today
Tell them their current process is outdated
Immediately offer a discount to make switching easier
Move on to a different prospect

questions.explanation: Start by understanding their real cost — time, drop-off, compliance risk — before positioning Ditto against it. Don't lead with criticism or price.

questions.prompt: How confident do you feel handling this kind of objection on a live call?
Put these four steps of handling an objection in the right order.

items.label: Acknowledge the concern without agreeing or dismissing it
Ask a question to understand what's really behind it
Respond with a specific, relevant point — not a generic pitch
Confirm the concern is resolved before moving on

questions.explanation: Acknowledge, then clarify, then respond, then confirm. Jumping straight to a response before clarifying is the most common mistake.

questions.prompt: Describe a recent call where an objection came up. What would you do differently next time?
questions.placeholder: A sentence or two is fine.
